name: phone lobby
eval: (() => { const m = document.getElementById('menu'); const r = m ? m.getBoundingClientRect() : null; return { viewport: [innerWidth, innerHeight], touchDetected: (navigator.maxTouchPoints||0) > 0, menuVisible: !!m && getComputedStyle(m).display !== 'none', menuWidth: r && Math.round(r.width), overflowX: document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth, buttons: [...document.querySelectorAll('#menu button')].filter(b => b.offsetParent).map(b => b.textContent.trim()).slice(0, 8) }; })()

name: phone lobby offenders
eval: (() => { const out = []; for (const e of document.querySelectorAll('body *')) { if (!e.offsetParent && e.tagName !== 'CANVAS') continue; const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width > 0 && (r.right > innerWidth + 1 || r.left < -1)) out.push(`${e.tagName.toLowerCase()}#${e.id || ''}.${String(e.className).split(' ')[0]} l=${Math.round(r.left)} r=${Math.round(r.right)}`); } return { innerWidth, offenders: out.slice(0, 12), count: out.length }; })()

name: play (phone)
eval: (() => { const n = document.querySelector('#menu input[type=text], #name'); if (n) { n.value = 'Phone'; n.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('#menu button')].find(b => /^(Play|Quick Play)$/i.test(b.textContent.trim())); if (!b) return 'no play button'; b.click(); return 'submitted'; })()
